value.rationale: The result gives a general structural law connecting finite-space core reduction with finite regular covering theory. Since the core determines ordinary homotopy type of a finite T0-space, the formula directly controls how irreducible finite-space complexity behaves under covers. The RP2 application cleanly separates weak homotopy equivalence from finite-space homotopy equivalence.
